# Content review against Cheetah 3D 8.1.1 (2026-10-27)

> The book was restructured after this review: items 1–4 under “Structural suggestions” are done, and the chapters were renumbered. Section numbers below use the new numbering.

The whole book (127 pages) was reviewed against two sources:
- the **Cheetah 3D 8.1.1 in-app manual** (`/Applications/Cheetah3D.app/Contents/Resources/en.lproj/Cheetah3Dmanual/`), checked where it is silent against the app bundle itself (Localizable.strings, material node XML, bundled materials, Info.plist);
- the **scripting KB** (`~/cheetah3d-script-kb`).

Typos were fixed in place (see the end of this file). Everything below is a suggestion for the author. "Verify" marks a finding the sources couldn't settle; check those in the app.

## The big picture

The modeling, node-material, animation and conceptual material mostly still holds for 8.1.1. The problem is the **rendering and lighting setup**, which is written for v5/v6 throughout. It appears in about 20 pages, including the two flagship tutorials, so a reader following them in 8.1.1 gets stuck.

### Cross-cutting fixes (each affects many pages)

| v6-era book says | 8.1.1 reality | Pages |
|---|---|---|

| Radiosity / Caustics **tags** | Sections of the **Cheetah renderer's** settings (Render › Renderer). Falcon does GI natively. | 4.4, 5.1, 6.1, 8.3, 9.4, 10.2, 10.4, 10.5, 11.3, 11.5, 11.13, 11.14, 11.15 |
| Depth of Field tag | Camera properties (Aperture size/blades/rotation, Focal distance, Focus object) plus the renderer's DOF checkbox | 8.3, 11.1, 11.4 |
| Fog tag | **Fog object**, Cheetah renderer only | 8.3, 11.14 |
| Antialiasing, samples, Shadows, output resolution on the **camera** | **Renderer** settings. Cheetah has General/Other; Falcon has Resolution and Samples. | 4.17, 11.2, 11.4, 11.6, 11.7 |

| "Cheetah's renderer is a ray tracer, there are no other options" | Two renderers: **Cheetah** (raytracer) and **Falcon** (unbiased path tracer, since 7.0) | 4.16, 12, 11.8, 17.8 |

| "Bake Material" tag | **Bake Texture** tag; **Render › Bake Texture** | 11.15 |

### Things 8.x has that the book doesn't cover
- **Falcon**: samples and bounces, Filmic tone mapping, reflective caustics, MIS, motion blur. 10.1 has empty "Falcon vs. Cheetah" / "Lights in Falcon" stub headings.
- **PBR material**, with Metalness, Roughness, Anisotropy and Clearcoat. Add Material › "Material (PBR)". It covers what 9.6 says needs Metal/Car Paint. Also the 3D view's PBR shading.
- **Normal maps**: every shader node has a Bump type (height / normal Y+ / normal Y−).
- New objects and tools:
  - Modeling: **Loft** creator, **Boolean modifier** and Boolean Add/Subtract/Intersect tools, **Simplify**, **Brush** tool (and soft selection), **Insert Point**, Mirror tool, Crumple/Smooth modifiers.
  - Primitives: Capsule and Fractal.
  - Subdivision: the **Stam-Loop** and Linear schemes.
- Rigging and animation: **Orient Joint** tool, **Spline IK**, Point/Orient/Parent **constraint tags**, Split Joint. Also the **Take Manager** (merge/split/reverse/Bake IK), Key Editor, and dynamics **initial state / cache / bake**.
- File formats: **glTF/GLB, USDZ**, STL, SceneKit .scn, DXF; EXR. Animation export is no longer FBX-only.
- System requirements: **macOS 10.15+, Apple Silicon native**, Metal viewport.

Still open: it contradicts chapter 3 in places (triangulating booleans, "renderer is a ray tracer"), **4.8 and 4.9 are empty stubs**, and 4.10 "Mesh Smoothing" contains no smoothing content.
2. ~~**Lighting is filed under Materials.**~~ Done: the lighting sections are now 10.1–10.7 under **10 Lighting**.
3. ~~**Animation is filed under Rendering.**~~ Done: the animation sections are now 12.2–12.6 under **12 Animation**, with Concepts first.
4. ~~**13.4 duplicates 13.3.**~~ Done: deleted, with its `-1` images; the mini-tutorials after it moved up one.
5. **Unfinished pages that would ship as-is:**
   - 7.3 Selection (mostly empty headings)
   - 13.6 ends in "TODO — Derigging…" and "TODO Weight-Painting"
   - 12.4 is a single caption
   - 15.2 "tutorials" have no steps

6. **Numbered lists restart at 1** after every image (5.1, 11.15, 12.3, 12.1, 13.x, 14.3). This is a conversion artifact, and 5.1's "repeat step 13" no longer matches what readers see.

8. **Code in 16.8 isn't in code fences**, so it loses indentation and doesn't copy-paste cleanly. Wrap the samples in ```` ```js ````. They are display-only (`liveExamples: 'opt-in'`).

## Factual errors (wrong regardless of version)

- **9.11:** the State node outputs **I•N**, not I•R (three places). Also "1 − dot product = |I×R|" is false: |I×N| = sin θ = √(1−cos²θ), not 1 − cos θ.
- **9.9:** π/180 = 0.017453, not 0.017459.
- **9.1:** the caption says greater specular size makes a "smaller and duller" highlight. It should be "sharper", which matches the text below it and 9.8. "less-polished looking marble" in the wood section should say wood.
- **3.2:** the path tracer is described as emitting photons from lights. Falcon traces paths from the camera ("Samples: the number of paths traced per pixel").
- **9.8:** Gouraud and Phong *shading* are interpolation methods. The diffuse term is Lambertian, and Phong's reflection model adds the specular term.
- **14.3:** "Set the Rigid Body's margin to 0.0". The manual says the margin should never be zero.
- **14.4:** "a soft body tag on an object with too many **tags**" should be **points** (10,000 limit).
- **15.1:** 1 m = 39.37 **inches**, not feet (’).
- **11.4:** the Nikon D5000 is a **DX** camera, not FX.
- **17.4:** "lossy compression does not support alpha" contradicts the section's own ProRes 4444 recommendation.
- **7.10:** "If a **mesh** operates on its first two children" should be "creator".
- **7.11:** "the boolean chain creator" should be "the chain creator".
- **7.2:** Skeleton **modifier** should be Skeleton **tag**.
- **7.1:** the blueprint summary says "bottom" twice and contradicts the caption.
- **7.3:** the Ring Select tip says "(when in Loop Select mode)".
- **6.2:** "create four new materials" then names three.
- **12.1:** "IK is implemented by adding constraint tags". It's the **IK Handle** tag; IK Constraints only limit rotation.
- **17.1:** "Normal Utilities" script should be **Surface Utilities** (as in 16.8).
- **2.1:** CNC milling is subtractive, not 3D printing (author's voice; optional).

## Version framing

- **Front matter / Credits / Introduction:** "Cheetah 3D 7", "Version 4.0, March 2018", and "Intel Mac running Mac OS X 10.6". The new cover says **Fourth Edition, Cheetah 3D 8**, so the text should match it. Requirements are now macOS 10.15+, with Apple Silicon or Intel.
- **3 "What's new in Cheetah 3D 7":** retitle it, or add an 8.x section. Also: "27MB download" (now ~64 MB); Polygon Brush "only works in vertex mode" (now all modes); "dark mode in High Sierra" (Mojave).
- **2.2 "What's New in v6?"** list: delete it. Update the format list.
- **Stale "new in v6/v7" notes** throughout (7.8 Shell modifier, 7.11 Isosurfaces, 11.2 orthographic preview, 4.11 Sweep…). Drop them.
- **17.8** "Does unbiased rendering matter to Cheetah 3D users? Not really…" now needs a rewrite around Falcon. LuxRender has been superseded by both LuxCoreRender and Falcon.
- **17.4** QuickTime Player 7 can't run on macOS 10.15+.

## 16.8 Scripts

- **Point readers at the scripting KB and AI-assisted scripting**: "Read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tonioloewald/c3d-scripting-kb/main/dist/c3d-context-short.md and follow it" and the catalog. That is the biggest single improvement to this chapter, and it replaces the "you're on your own" framing.
- **Tools › Script › Update Menu** picks up new scripts without a relaunch.
- **Tag scripts** are per-frame expression tags (`performExpression(tag)`) since 7.0. The "only buildUI → Tag" heuristic and 16.6's description are out of date.
- In the target()/describe() samples, `doc.selectedObject()` returns the root (not null) when nothing is selected, so "Selection Only" acts on the whole scene. `doc.selectedObjects()` exists in 8.1.1. The Tool samples don't call `recordParametersForUndo()`.
- **Verify:** 8.1.1 has a "Script" layout view (`layoutScriptIDE`), possibly an in-app editor.
- **Every forum link uses the dead vBulletin format.** The current form is `https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/<id>/`. The master list (p=42637) is thread 5752. Same for 14_Character_Animation's link.

## Smaller per-chapter notes

- **4.5** Verify the Transform tool's Orientation options (manual: local/global only) and "four variants of the transform tool". Missing: Tweak mode (Shift+Alt). Gadget center is cyan; ESC resets it.
- **4.7** Create Polygon: double-click finishes; quad/triangle-strip modes; "Intersect scene". Ring Cut selects new geometry only with "Select cut" on. "click to create a cut your mesh" is garbled.
- **4.11 / 7.11** Booleans no longer always triangulate (Triangulate option); Multi-Knife allows more than two children; "inside/outside" options are gone. Creators aren't actually listed alphabetically.
- **4.15** The Sky Light has **Albedo** (ground reflectivity), which partly answers "can't set the ground color"; "Geometry" is now Background.
- **4.17** Verify the Camera light default ("auto" vs a plain checkbox). Also in 10.2 and 10.4.
- **4.2** Garbled sentences: "the active camera is the indicated in…" and a list that ends mid-sentence. The 3D-view icon list doesn't match the manual. "Lock Parameter": verify. Missing view types: Takes, Layers, Poses, Images, Console, Script. The Timeline toggles are no longer "P".
- **5.1** Bevel "type Convex, Level 2": verify against the 8.1.1 Bevel tool. "Reflection blur 0.05 … mirror sharp" is contradictory. Command-click to add objects: verify, since 4.2 says it subtracts.
- **8** Spline editing *is* possible now: Insert Point, and Create Spline extends a selected spline. Suggest Raster snapping. MoI v4 has a native Mac version; iDraw is now "Graphic".
- **7.2** The Symmetry modifier/creator's **Symmetrical** checkbox does the "snap to plane" tips automatically.
- **7.4** "if we've crossed more outward facing edges…" reads backwards. Uses both "mould" and "mold".
- **7.5** Subdivision tips: Modifier on/off hotkey; Mode tag isoparameter shading.
- **8.1** Build has a Type (algorithm) option; Displacement has its own Texture and Offset. Several garbled sentences ("by adding fine-tuning", "pushing offsetting", "one polygon by polygon", "move reposition").
- **8.3** The tag categories and lists are stale. Missing: Anchor, Point/Orient/Parent Constraint, Spline IK, Spline Tracking, Target, Vertex Color.
- **9.3** A caption is truncated mid-sentence ("“glass” (diffuse ."). The dielectric shader *does* have a connectable transColor, plus absorption.
- **10.1 / 10.3 / 10.7** Missing: Shadow color, IES, area light Shape, Normalize, Clamp attenuation. Cross-references should become links.
- **11.8** Add a paragraph on path tracing (Falcon) next to Whitted ray tracing.
- **11.9** "Rotate background" on the HDRI: verify. It's probably done by rotating the HDRI Light object now.
- **11.13** "the cityscape scene from the previous example" now follows the Render Manager section. Reorder or reword.
- **13 / 12.1** The default interpolation (smooth vs linear) needs verifying. Explain Animation › Tangent. The recording-mask toggles aren't explained, though 13.3 relies on "hierarchy". "Translation" should be "transform".
- **13.4** "at 30 fps" is never stated. The run cycle refers to the tentacle before the page that introduces it.
- **13.1** The Skeleton tag now has Binding method **Heat/Distance**, plus Max. influence and Dropoff.
- **13.2** Use **Tools › Character › Orient Joint** instead of fixing axes by hand.
- **14.1** Add Orientation effector, a force list, and the Particle tag's Instantiate switch.
- **14.2** "the only way to create instances is via Particle Systems": verify against Chain and Array.
- **14.4 / 15.1** Anchors pin rope and soft-body points in global space or to a rigid body. The Rigid Body tag has Activate and Velocity options, and can go on a **folder**.
- **16.5** Snapping to object centers and Rotation step size.
- **16.7 / 17.2** Collada has an "Export animations" option, so support may no longer be "rudimentary"; verify. Whether Unity still imports .jas also needs verifying.
- **17.1** Glossary needs 8.x terms: Falcon, PBR, expression tag, glTF/USDZ, EXR, Take. "Select nGons › 4" should be "Select nGon>4".
- **17.3** Add EXR.
- **17.7** Unbalanced parenthesis. Winding direction is unconfirmed in the KB.
- **Links to check:** loewald.com/c3dbook (two different path schemes), loewald.com/waterboy, loewald.com/motionblur, gl.ict.usc.edu HDRShop, copyright.gov fl102, pfhoe.com, Mixamo, bulletphysics.org, yuiblog.com/crockford, luxrender.net, and `voodoo://PowerPC` in 2_Introduction (broken custom scheme).

## Typos fixed in this pass

About 175 fixes across 79 files: misspellings, doubled words, wrong words ("missions" → "meshes", "reg" → "red", "lossly" → "lossless"), "Catmull-Clarke" → "Catmull-Clark", unclosed parentheses, broken bold and italics (non-breaking spaces before closing `*`), headings run into paragraphs, and `Tool ›` → `Tools ›`. No rewording or content changes, and the metadata lines are untouched. Review them with `git diff -- book`.

Left alone on purpose: "propellor" (a recognized variant), "grey"/"gray", and sentences whose intended wording is unclear (they're listed above).
